brief: inline (owner overruled S30 via S35): build a discovery map that records where you have been, with no possible quest-marker surface
outputs_expected: game/src/sim/discovery.js (discovery model, in the fixed step)
game/src/ui/screens/map.js (world + local view, drawn from world data)
save/state.js discovery block + live-world load audit
findings: ARBITRATION S30 struck, S35 rules: map permitted, records where you HAVE BEEN; every marker prohibition kept. S35 explicitly says whoever builds it owns the RI-UIX04 JU8 amendment.

RI-UIX04 JU8 = 'No map anywhere (Q7)': pass = `map` unreachable AND non-existent; hard fail = a map exists. Q7 row in §B is 'Any map, minimap, or map page in or reachable from the journal'. Scoring note: Q3/Q6/Q7 hits trigger AR-2.

game/src/ui/system.js is the whole UI: MODES/OPENABLE closed lists, `open()` THROWS on 'map'|'minimap'|'worldmap', state() reports map_exists:false, navigable() never contains map. Header comment rule 3 is 'THERE IS NO MAP'. This is the file to amend.

RI-UIX03 §A pause rule: menu pauses OUTSIDE combat, runs at 60Hz INSIDE combat. UISystem.pausesSimulation(inCombat) = mode!=='world' && mode!=='dialogue' && !inCombat — a new 'map' mode inherits the correct rule for free.

World data: terrain.json is a 193x222 grid at cell_m=25 over 4825x5540 m, base64 channels (base_dm int16, region uint8, ocean uint8, land bits) decoded by game/src/world/field.js (WorldField). regions.json has 13 regions each with palette_hex. pois.json: 8 settlement + 16 minor-settlement + 10 landmark + 8 waystation = 42 places.

Existing discovery precedent: sim.progression.hearthsDiscovered (array, saved in save/state.js progression.hearths_discovered, written by sim/death.js restAt). sim.env.settlement/.interior written every frame by sim/settlement.js stepSettlement.

game/src/world/province.js setSignposts() ALREADY cites seam S35 in its header — 'Seam S35 permits a map but confines it to ground the player has already walked, so the map is blank in the one direction the player needs it.' Wayfinding-without-map is already built (signposts).
AGENT-PROTOCOL: audit the LIVE WORLD after a load, not the blob — a written-never-read field re-serialises and passes forever. Vary WHEN you save, not just the seed.

Q7's TEXT is narrow: 'Any map, minimap, or map page IN OR REACHABLE FROM THE JOURNAL'. The EXISTENCE clause lives only in the JU8 scoring row ('map unreachable AND non-existent') and in method 7's second sentence ('the map must not exist at all') and in the 'how we lose' bullet. So the amendment is SURGICAL: keep Q7, J8, Q8 verbatim; replace only the existence half of JU8 + method 7. Map must still NOT be reachable from the journal — navigable() in journal mode must never contain 'map'.

ui/surface.js FORBIDDEN_KINDS already contains 'map','map_pin','quest_marker','waypoint','minimap','objective_tracker'. Do NOT add 'map' as an element kind — add new kinds (map_terrain/map_place/map_player/map_local) so the forbidden-kind census still reads 0.
UISurface.el(rec, draw) is the ONLY drawing path and it CLIPS to the declared rect — you cannot draw undeclared. So the map's census and its pixels cannot disagree.

pois.json: 42 places with pos[] and kind. terrain.json `sites` carry r_flat / r_falloff — the WORLD's own definition of each place's extent, so 'personally stood in' = inside the site's own radius, non-arbitrary and drawn from world data.
terrain grid 193x222 @ 25 m => 42,846 cells; a discovery bitset is 5,356 bytes / ~7.1 KB base64 — cheap enough to save verbatim.
notes_for_successor: Decision taken: roads are NOT drawn on the map. S35 forbids 'a route, path, trail or line of any kind' and a drawn road is the first thing a hostile critic will call a line. Wayfinding stays with signposts (already in the world).
